title: The Power of Influence Is Built in the Little Things
gist: A CNAS video interview features JoAnne 'Jo' Bass, the first woman to serve as Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force, discussing leadership as an adjunct senior fellow at CNAS.

insights.claim: JoAnne 'Jo' Bass served as the 19th Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force and was the first woman to hold the position of highest-ranking enlisted leader in any U.S. military service.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: A notable representation milestone in US military leadership, relevant to tracking personnel-policy and human-capital trends at the Pentagon.
insights.locator: the 19th Chief Master Sergeant of the Air Force

insights.claim: Bass is now an adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, continuing to engage in national-security discourse after her military career.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: Signals CNAS's continued recruitment of senior former military leaders into its human-capital and personnel research program.
insights.locator: now an adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security
